config.attracttochat.capsRangeBonus.tool: Extra range per CAPS word in the message.
config.attracttochat.enableAntiSpam.tool: Prevents players from spamming messages to continuously attract mobs.
config.attracttochat.enableAttractionSou: Play a subtle sound when a mob is attracted.
Chatting a lot causes temporary fatigue — mobs are harder to attract.
config.attracttochat.enabledEntities.too: List of entity IDs that can be attracted by chat (e.g. minecraft:zombie).
config.attracttochat.fatigueThreshold.to: Character count before fatigue kicks in.
config.attracttochat.forgetTargetAfterSe: Seconds before a mob forgets the chat location. If the player disappears before this, the mob forgets immediately.
config.attracttochat.hearingRange.toolti: Maximum radius (blocks) a player's chat is heard by nearby mobs.
config.attracttochat.ignoredPlayers.tool: Players in this list will not attract mobs with their chat.
config.attracttochat.mobSpeedBase.toolti: Base speed multiplier when mob is attracted.
config.attracttochat.mobSpeedMax.tooltip: Maximum speed multiplier — reached when mob is far from target.
config.attracttochat.scanCooldownTicks.t: Minimum ticks between each attraction scan per player. 20 = 1 second.
config.attracttochat.showAttractionParti: Draw a bright particle path from each investigating mob to the message origin (nav path when available). Only clients with ATC installed can opt in with /atc client particles enable.
config.attracttochat.silentAntiSpam.tool: Silently blocks spam without notifying the player.
config.attracttochat.title: Attract-To-Chat Settings
config.attracttochat.traumaDuration.tool: How long (ticks) the player is muted after hitting the fatigue limit.
config.attracttochat.trollMode.tooltip: Multiplies attraction range by 4. For chaos.
